# Copilot Instructions

All repo guidance lives in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — commands, code conventions, key contracts, and the project map. Follow it.

Task-specific workflow guides (plain Markdown, tool-agnostic) are in [`.claude/skills/`](../.claude/skills/): `verify-changes`, `add-stats-dimension`, `release`, `ui-conventions`, `db-conventions`, `agent-probe-dev`. Consult the matching guide before changes to stats/schema, UI, releases, or the Go agent.
